stem: The mean age of the \(n\) members of a chess club is 16 years. When a 46-year-old coach and a 40-year-old assistant coach join the club, the mean age of the group increases to 19 years. What is the value of \(n\)?
solution: The total age of the members is \(16n\). After the coaches join, the total is \(16n + 46 + 40 = 16n + 86\) for \(n + 2\) people.
verify:
n = symbols('n')
sol = solve(Eq(16*n + 46 + 40, 19*(n + 2)), n)
assert sol == [16]
assert Rational(spr_answers[0]) == sol[0] and len(spr_answers) == 1
